lines: Jamegi kaise bisaat-e-yaaran, ki sheesha-o-jaam bujh gaye hain
couplets.en: How shall friends gather when the flask and cup have lost their glow?

lines: Woh teergi hai raah-e-butaan mein, charaagh-e-rukh hai na sham-e-waada
couplets.en: The path to the beloved lies dark, without the glow of a face or the candle of a promise.

lines: Kiran koi aarzu ki laao, ki sab dar-o-baam bujh gaye hain
couplets.en: Bring a ray of longing, for every doorway and rooftop has gone dark.

lines: Sajegi kaise shab-e-nigaraan, ki dil sar-e-shaam bujh gaye hain
couplets.en: How shall the night of beauties shine when hearts went dark at dusk?

lines: Qareeb aa ai mah-e-shab-e-gham, nazar pe khulta nahin kuchh is dam
couplets.en: Come nearer, moon of this sorrowful night, for my eyes can make out nothing now.

lines: Ki dil pe kis kis ka naqsh baaqi hai, kaun se naam bujh gaye hain
couplets.en: Whose traces remain on the heart, and which names have gone dark?

lines: Sajegi kaise shab-e-nigaraan, ki dil sar-e-shaam bujh gaye hain
couplets.en: How shall the night of beauties shine when hearts went dark at dusk?

lines: Bahaar ab aa ke kya karegi, ki jin se tha jashn-e-rang-o-naghma
couplets.en: What can spring do now, when those who filled it with color and song are gone?

lines: Woh gul sar-e-shaakh jal gaye hain, woh dil tah-e-daam bujh gaye hain
couplets.en: Those roses burned on the branch, and those hearts went dark in the snare.
